definition: One of the seven awakening factors, named here in its specific form.
notes: Inherit the `pīti` headword, which records an explicit rule that meditative-development and bojjhaṅga contexts take `rejoicing`. The record read `delight awakening factor` until 2026-09-13, contradicting that rule and both translation surfaces that list the seven factors; `delight` is kept only as the headword's explanatory alternate.

example_phrases.notes: The running-text form in SN 46.1, where all seven factors are named in the same sentence shape.
